lines: Q: What's the hardest part of meals for you? Or something else.
A: Remembering to order what the meals need, honestly.

Q: Which apps do you order groceries on: Zepto, Blinkit, Instamart, BigBasket or Amazon? If you sign me in, I'll read your past orders to learn what your home buys and how often, so the plan and the shopping list fit you from the first week, and I can fill the cart for you. Nothing is ordered without your yes.
A: Only Instamart.
A: Sign in later maybe.
Q: Which is your main app, and which do you use when something isn't there?
A: Only Instamart, I told you already.
A: Don't really use anything else.
Q: I have Karthik (36), Meenakshi (33) and Ananya (5) eating at home. Anyone else who eats at home, or anyone who doesn't?
A: Just the three of us.
A: No one else.
Q: Who cooks at home, and on which days? Is any day's meal eaten out?
A: Meenakshi cooks every day, all seven days.
A: We order in on Friday dinner, usually from Saravana Bhavan.
Q: What did the children have for breakfast over the past week? Tell me in as much detail as you can.
A: Ananya had idli most days, dosa a couple of times, and ragi porridge once. Same as us.
Q: The children's lunch over the past week, or their school tiffin?
A: Ananya eats lunch at home after playschool, same as us. Rice with sambar or rasam and curd.
Q: The children's dinner over the past week?
A: Same as ours, just less spicy. Dosa or chapati with kurma mostly.
Q: What did the adults have for breakfast over the past week? Tell me in as much detail as you can.
A: Same as Ananya mostly — idli, dosa, upma, pongal on Sundays. With coconut chutney and sambar.
Q: The adults' lunch over the past week?
A: Rice with sambar or rasam, a poriyal like beans or cabbage, and curd. I take the same in my lunch box.
Q: The adults' dinner over the past week?
A: Same as what I said for dinner — dosa or chapati with kurma, sometimes uthappam, or rasam rice if it's late.
Q: Is anyone on a diet? High protein, low carb, diabetic, anything a doctor asked for.
A: No diets. Pure vegetarian, no eggs though.
A: And I won't touch brinjal. Ananya needs less spicy.
Q: Any food rules for the house? Veg, egg or non-veg days, fasting days, allergies, a dish someone won't touch.
A: Told you already — pure vegetarian, no eggs. I won't eat brinjal, and Ananya needs less spicy.
Q: How often do you order in, and on which days?
A: Once a week, Friday dinner. From Saravana Bhavan on Swiggy usually.
